python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# FY 1981 Net budget outlays by month (in millions)
data = [59099, 53969, 54216, 57198, 54608, 55619, 58486, 53095, 53698, 64216, 56838, 76875]

# Calculate population standard deviation
n = len(data)
mean = sum(data) / n
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in data) / n
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

print(f"Data points: {data}")
print(f"Count: {n}")
print(f"Mean: {mean}")
print(f"Sum: {sum(data)}")
print(f"Variance: {variance}")
print(f"Population Standard Deviation: {std_dev}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(std_dev, 2)}")
EOF
